build_transformerxl_model: build a TransformerXL language model with GPT2 blocks and adaptive softmax embedding for sequence prediction
run_sequence_prediction_metrics: run sequence_prediction_metrics to compute loss, token accuracy, and log probabilities from logits and labels
build_graph2text_transformer: build a Graph2TextTransformer that encodes graphs with a GNN and conditions text generation on graph embeddings
build_bow2text_transformer: build a Bow2TextTransformer that embeds bag-of-words vectors as extra tokens for the TransformerXL to attend to
test_unpack_and_pad: test the unpack_and_pad function to split and pad concatenated tensors to a uniform size with masks
